746890101.text: (...Could they be the ones Master mentioned? The golden-haired traveler, and that flying fairy dressed in white...)

746890102.text: Huh? Why are you staring at us and muttering like that? Is there something weird on our faces?

746890103.text: Ah! M—My apologies! I didn't mean to! I just... I just thought...

746890106.text: #I... I'm Ninette, and my master is Lepine-Pauline. She told me about you... said you're the legendary adventurer {NICKNAME}, and that you travel with your best companion, Paimon!

746890107.text: I... I never imagined I'd really get to see you in person...

746890108.text: Oh! So you're Lepine-Pauline's apprentice! Guess her business has really been booming lately, huh?

746890109.text: Yes! And it's all thanks to her that I was able to get back on my feet after a really hard time.

746890111.text: I used to study photography under another teacher.

746890112.text: I wanted to make it on my own someday, so I spent all my savings on the best Kamera equipment I could afford.

746890113.text: My teacher said my skills weren't bad, and I really believed that if I just took good photos, I'd be able to make a living.

746890114.text: But... when I actually went out on the streets and saw people, I got so nervous that I couldn't get a single word out.

746890115.text: Every time I tried to say, "Hello, would you like a photo?", the words just got stuck in my throat.

746890116.text: In the end, everyone just went to the photographers who were friendlier and better at talking to people.

746890117.text: Before I knew it, I'd almost run out of Mora... and I even thought about selling my Kamera just to get by...

746890119.text: It was right then that I met Master Lepine-Pauline.

746890120.text: When she saw my equipment and the photos I'd taken, she encouraged me and had me work with her to test a new lens.

746890121.text: She said there was a calm, gentle quality in my photos... something she didn't see in anyone else's.

746890122.text: So when Master finally finished developing the Shutterflash lens, I was really happy! Probably even more than she was!

746890123.text: The Shutterflash lens? What kind of lens is that?

746890124.text: It captures every movement and expression perfectly, even when the subject's moving really fast!

746890125.text: But... it's still in the final testing phase, so we need to take a lot of real-world photos to gather data and make sure it works properly.

746890126.text: Since Master's been tied up with other work, she handed this task to me. I was thinking I could try finding a few people to help with the testing...

746890127.text: But... it happened again. Whenever I tried to talk to someone I didn't know, I got all flustered and couldn't make any sense...

746890128.text: Everyone just looked at me kind of confused... they probably thought I was acting suspicious or something. A few days went by, and I still couldn't find anyone willing to help.

746890129.text: *sobbing*... I couldn't even handle something this easy... I guess I really am hopeless...

746890130.text: Hey, hey, don't cry! It's really not your fault, okay?

746890131.text: Really, asking strangers for help like that is hard for anyone!
